title: Desk Guide: Full-Value Portion of Early-Retired Rows Already Begun by a Percentage Resolution — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Full-Value Portion of Rows Already Begun by a Percentage Resolution

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), distribution-margin rows retired under an approved discounted early retirement.**

**Rule.** A row the board has already begun to retire by a percentage resolution keeps part of its gross at full value:

- where the general retirements already booked on the row are at least **15 percent (0.15)** of its original allocation, **25 percent (0.25)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- where they are above zero and below 15 percent, **10 percent (0.1)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- a row never touched by a general retirement has no part paid at full value.

The discount acts only on the rest of the gross. The row's payable then consists of the full-value part together with the discounted rest.

## Reading the records

- **General retirements already booked on the row:** the total of the general retirement entries on that distribution-margin allocation year of the account.
- **Original allocation:** the distribution-margin allocation of that year as booked.
- **Share:** the first divided by the second.
- **Gross:** the original allocation less the general retirements already booked.

## Share and full-value portion

| Share already retired by general retirements | Part of the gross paid at full value |
|---|---|
| 15 percent or more | 25 percent |
| more than 0 and less than 15 percent | 10 percent |
| none | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical rows)

| Original allocation | Already retired | Share | Full-value part of the gross |
|---|---|---|---|
| $400.00 | $60.00 | exactly 15 percent | 25 percent |
| $400.00 | $59.96 | 14.99 percent | 10 percent |
| $400.00 | $0.01 | above zero | 10 percent |
| $400.00 | $0.00 | none | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical discount)

Original allocation $400.00, general retirements already booked $60.00, gross $340.00. With a discount that leaves 0.70 of value on the rest:

1. Full-value part: 25 percent of $340.00 is $85.00.
2. Rest: $255.00; discounted, 0.70 of it is $178.50.
3. The row is paid $85.00 together with $178.50, a total of $263.50.
